scripts.cap:sync: vite build --mode android && cap sync android

scripts.aab:release:win: vite build --mode android && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.aab:release:unix: vite build --mode android && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
